doctrine: Orthogonal fractals × chordials. The grid is 4px-based, doubling. Every decorative element is derived from the unit cell. One toroidal anchor per page — no more.

unit_cell.name: orthogonal_fractal_unit_cell
unit_cell.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='16' height='16' viewBox='0 0 16 16'><path d='M0 0 H4 V4 M12 0 V4 H16 M8 8 V16 M0 12 H4 V8' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/><circle cx='4' cy='12' r='1' fill='currentColor'/></svg>
unit_cell.tiling: seamless — all marks share the grid

chordials.name: chordial_lines
chordials.rationale: lines through shared points, orthogonal or stellated

torus_rationale.rule: Exactly ONE toroidal anchor per page. Two or more = design VOID.

trinity_ring.description: Three arcs around the AAA bridge center. Used on trinity-tile pages and constellation views.

mission_wheel.description: Concentric arcs representing the six missions (Investigate, Interpret, Decide, Build, Monitor, Remember).

torus_rationale.violation: design VOID — the lint block will catch it at build
torus_rationale.lint_rule: page renders at most one toroidal anchor

/arif.use: bare white — absence of pattern is the marker

grid.rationale: Doubling — same fractal pattern as the unit cell, expressed as spacing

hairline.use: row separators, table dividers, agent-mode edges

emphasis.use: zone markers, scope labels, callout boundaries

sharp.use: domain labels, code chips, ident tags

subtle.use: table cells, small chips, breadcrumb separators

signature: Fractal corner-notch on every card. The unit cell is the brand.

lint_rules.name: one_torus_per_page
lint_rules.rule: page renders at most one toroidal anchor (trinity_ring OR mission_wheel, never both)

lint_rules.name: torus_present_on_trinity_pages
lint_rules.rule: /human, /institution, /earth, /arif — all must include one toroidal anchor or be explicitly marked flat-surface

lint_rules.name: sovereign_bare
lint_rules.rule: /arif background-image must be 'none'. No fractal on sovereign.
